No. 7 of 2025
AN ACT to amend the Supreme Court Act, Cap. 2.01.
[ 31st March, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

94
No. 7 ] Supreme Court (Amendment) Act [ 2025
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Supreme Court (Amendment)
Act, 2025.
Interpretation
2. In this Act, “principal Act” means the Supreme Court Act,
Cap. 2.01.
Amendment of section 2
3. Section 2 of the principal Act is amended by deleting the
definition for the word “verdict” and by substituting the following —
“ “verdict” includes —
(a) in the case of a trial by judge and jury, the finding
of a jury and the decision of the judge; or
(b) in the case of a trial by judge alone, the finding of
the judge alone;”
Amendment of section 35
4. Section 35 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (1),
by inserting immediately after the word “jury” the words “or judge”.
Amendment of section 36
5. Section 36 of the principal Act is amended by inserting
immediately after the word “jury”, wherever it appears, the words
“or judge”.

95
No. 7 ] Supreme Court (Amendment) Act [ 2025
Amendment of section 37
6. Section 37 of the principal Act is amended by inserting
immediately after the word “jury”, wherever it appears, the words
“or judge”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 11th day of March, 2025.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 18th day of March, 2025.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
